agentstats.help:
deckent agents stats [<agent-id>] [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Shows how the scope's agents did on real work, per revision and WorkClass: accepted outcomes, a confidence interval, time, measured cost, every failure kind and what was set apart, beside the WorkClass overall and the promoted agent. With an agent id: every revision in the window, a split by model, each pinned skill and the team total of its reports. Numbers are associations, not causes, and acceptance rates, not accuracy; only failures that belong to the worker (failed criteria, its own report, a person's rejection) count.
agentstats.title: Agent statistics · association, not causation · acceptance rate, not accuracy
agentstats.mode.off: Aggregation pass: off. These numbers are read from the sealed metrics now.
agentstats.mode.shadow: Aggregation pass: shadow. It records statistics and sealed suggestions marked shadow; no card and no narrowing.
agentstats.mode.on: Aggregation pass: on. It records statistics and sealed suggestions for your cards; it narrows only on rules marked calibrated.
agentstats.registry.calibrated: agreed by a person on real work: acceptance rate, not accuracy
agentstats.truncated: · read bound reached, older rows are not included
agentstats.lastPass: Last pass: up to row {position}, {keys} key(s), {mode}, {ago}
agentstats.lastPass.none: No aggregation pass has run in this scope yet.
agentstats.effort: time p50 {p50}, p90 {p90} · measured cost {cost} · quota waits {quota} · decided by a person {human}
agentstats.failures: counted failures: criteria {criteria}, worker report {report}, rejected by a person {human}
agentstats.uncounted: not counted against the agent: infrastructure {infra}, model {model}, dependency {dependency}, policy {policy}, operator {operator}, no cause recorded {unattributed}
agentstats.excluded: set apart: awaiting a decision {awaiting}, only unknown evidence {unknown}, older record format {legacy}, no sealed time {undated}, Run incomplete {incomplete}
agentstats.baseline: WorkClass overall without this agent: {line} · time ratio {ratio}
agentstats.config.section: Agent catalog aggregation (protected; no AI may change it): mode turns on the pass that records agent and skill statistics and sealed suggestions from sealed metrics (off; shadow: suggestions as evidence only, no card or narrowing; on: suggestions for cards, narrowing only on calibrated rules); the pass writes only signed by the aggregator's own key; overlay replaces registry rule rows or lowers its bounds.
error.CATALOG_EVOLUTION_REGISTRY_UNAVAIL: The catalog statistics rules are missing or invalid. No statistic was computed and nothing was written; Runs, agent selection and standings are unaffected.
error.CATALOG_EVOLUTION_CORRUPT: A catalog statistics record or metric row failed its integrity check. Nothing was changed.
error.CATALOG_EVOLUTION_POSITION_CONFLIC: Another aggregation pass of this scope moved first. Nothing was written twice; the next pass continues from its position.
mcp.tool.inspectAgentStats: Show agent statistics from sealed work: accepted outcomes with a confidence interval, time, measured cost, every failure kind and what was set apart, beside the WorkClass overall; with agentId also per revision, per model, per pinned skill and the team total. Associations, not causes; acceptance rates, not accuracy (read-only).
agentstats.config.name: Agent catalog aggregation
